guide_enrichment.narrative:
We understand the case for Wake Forest: Gio Lopez has opened the season with 575 passing yards, four touchdowns and no interceptions while adding 98 yards and two scores on the ground. Wake Forest has yet to commit a turnover, and Carlos Hernandez has produced 253 receiving yards. Still, we are not treating two clean offensive performances as proof that the underlying matchup is favorable.

Our longer-run numbers give Louisville the advantage against both the run and the pass, with an even clearer edge in preventing scoring opportunities. Wake Forest also allowed Purdue to throw for 329 yards and produce a 114-yard, three-touchdown rusher, while opponents have scored on every red-zone possession through two games. For us, those concerns offset the appeal of Lopez and the early offensive production. Our view is close enough to the market that the available price does not create sufficient value, so we pass.
guide_enrichment.matchup_to_watch: We are watching Lopez and Wake Forest's passing game against Louisville's pass defense. Lopez's mobility and his connection with Hernandez give Wake Forest ways to extend possessions, but our efficiency numbers favor Louisville on this side of the ball. The question is whether Wake Forest can turn drives into touchdowns against a defense our numbers rate well in scoring-opportunity prevention; that matchup is central to whether Wake Forest can stay inside the market's expectation.

recent_game.fact: Wake Forest defeated Purdue 38-36 in double overtime on Sept. 12, 2026, improving to 2-0.
On fourth-and-15 in the second overtime, Gio Lopez completed a 15-yard pass to Carlos Hernandez to extend the game, then scored the tying touchdown and the winning two-point conversion.
Against Purdue, Gio Lopez completed 16 of 27 passes for 225 yards and one touchdown and led Wake Forest with 59 rushing yards and two rushing touchdowns.
Carlos Hernandez caught six passes for 88 yards against Purdue.
Wake Forest committed no turnovers against Purdue.
Wake Forest allowed Purdue quarterback Ryan Browne to pass for 329 yards and Purdue running back Fame Ijeboi to rush for 114 yards and three touchdowns.

quarterback.fact: Gio Lopez is Wake Forest's projected starting quarterback.
Through two 2026 games, Lopez has completed 37 of 59 passes for 575 yards, four touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing 20 times for 98 yards and two touchdowns.
Lopez transferred to Wake Forest from North Carolina after starting 11 games there in 2025.
Before North Carolina, Lopez played at South Alabama under current Wake Forest offensive coordinator Rob Ezell.
Redshirt freshman Steele Pizzella is listed as the backup quarterback on Wake Forest's unofficial projected depth chart.
